verdict.rationale: Elicit's Research Agent could plausibly act as an MCP client, so this axis applies. However, the evidence only documents Elicit running as an MCP server that external clients such as Claude Code connect to. That is the opposite role and earns no credit here. Nothing shows users can add third-party MCP servers to Elicit so its agent can call their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
